title: Portolan — Helsinki federation (catalog of catalogs)
description: The root directory of the Portolan demo federation: a catalog of catalogs. Each child below is an independent, sovereign publisher exposing its own Apache Iceberg catalog on European object storage (UpCloud 🇫🇮), attached anonymously with DuckDB. Attach a child by its href and read its own STAC index table `catalog.datasets` (stac-geoparquet) — which lists only that publisher's datasets, each carrying its own OSI semantics, CRS and schema. That is the progressive discovery: this root → a publisher catalog → a dataset → a query you compose yourself. Each child carries a `bbox` (WGS84) so you can pre-filter to the catalogs whose extent covers your location before attaching. Adding a publisher is a new child link here; no client code changes. Today: 9 publishers, 18 datasets, spanning regional → national → EU → global (two non-geospatial, to show the SDI federates open data, not just maps).

links.title: 🇫🇮 National Land Survey of Finland (Maanmittauslaitos)
links.description: Authoritative topographic + elevation base data — the physical-infrastructure backbone: power lines, lakes, protected areas and buildings (national vectors), plus the 2 m laser elevation model (raquet raster, Helsinki-region clip).

links.title: 🇪🇺 Copernicus (European Union)
links.description: EU Earth observation + land monitoring: Sentinel-2 NDVI vegetation index, and Copernicus Urban Atlas 2018 land-use polygons for the Helsinki FUA (authoritative class per parcel). NDVI gives the index; Urban Atlas gives the class.

links.title: 🇫🇮 Finnish Environment Institute (SYKE)
links.description: Authoritative environmental / regulatory layers: flood-hazard zones (inundation extent by return period), Natura 2000 (SAC+SPA), and classified groundwater areas (VHS2022). Clipped to the Helsinki-region AOI.

links.title: 🏙️ Helsinki Region — HSY
links.description: Regional planning: SeutuRAMAVA per detailed-plan-block land-use category + unused building-rights reserve (built vs unused floor area by use class), aggregated from the municipal plans across Espoo / Vantaa / Kauniainen.

links.title: ⚡ Fingrid (national TSO) — non-geospatial
links.description: The Finnish transmission system operator. National grid load, 15-min MW time-series (30-day snapshot). No geometry — a plain table, here to show the SDI federates open data, not just maps.

links.title: 📊 Statistics Finland (Tilastokeskus)
links.description: Official statistics: Paavo postal-area demographics 2025 (population, income, employment, age) and the 1 km population grid 2025 (inhabitants + age groups per cell). The residential context at a site.

links.title: 🧭 Location Finland (Location Innovation Hub)
links.description: Finland's national location-data gateway: YKR settlement/urban-structure zones (urban→peripheral gradient) and mean annual air temperature (°C — a climate coverage as a raquet raster).

links.title: 🇪🇺 Eurostat (EU statistical office) — non-geospatial
links.description: EU statistical office. Industrial electricity price (€/kWh, incl. taxes), Finland vs EU-27 and other countries. No geometry.

links.title: 🌍 Overture Maps (global)
links.description: Planet-scale Overture places (points of interest). Overture already publishes cloud-native GeoParquet, so the dataset stays a remote GeoParquet on Overture's own public S3 and is queried in place — no copy, same pattern, at global scale. Its bbox is the whole world: it matches any location.
